title: Verb-phrase right label
description: Right header label changes from "Próxima salida" to "Sale en" — a verb phrase that reads naturally against the countdown values beneath it (e.g. "Sale en 12 min"), shifting the column from a noun label to an implied sentence fragment. Left label ("Destino") is unchanged.
